verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own API reference says the API description is available as OpenAPI 3.1 JSON for code generators, which is a machine-readable spec of the kind the story asks for. The probe got 404s only at guessed conventional paths (openapi.json, swagger.json and similar), not at a documented location, so it does not concretely contradict the claim, but it does lower confidence. Missing for 10: a documented download URL for the spec, independent or hands-on confirmation that the file can be retrieved, and detail on what the spec covers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The same description is available as OpenAPI 3.1 JSON for code generators
